description: Step 24 adversarially stress-tests the Step-23 group-shape generation. The widened enumeration covers factor counts 0..6, ranks 1..6, U(1)-role counts 0..3, and known chiral alternatives. There are 3699 candidates and 4 closers: SU(5), SO(10), SU(6)_chiral_example, and r1|2_u1. The split-sector 2|3 shape remains the primary winner under rank-first and slot-first orderings, but factor-count-first selects SU(5); stability is 8/9 criteria settings. Verdict: FRAGILE typed no-go for parameter-independent uniqueness, with next_grammar_delta requiring a discriminator between low-rank split-sector closure and one-factor simple unification economy.
